tools.NAME: DNS Security Analyzer
tools.DESCRIPTION: Audits SPF, DMARC, DKIM (named selectors), MX, NS redundancy, CAA and DNSSEC presence for one domain, from supplied records or passive DNS lookups. It does not probe mail servers or enumerate subdomains.
tools.SOURCE: CyberScan original implementation; dnspython (ISC) for live lookups

PRIVACY.data_handling: Only the domain name and its public DNS records are processed, in memory.
PRIVACY.external_services: With resolve=true, DNS queries for the domain's own records go to the system or given resolver.

tools.NAME: DNSSEC Validator
tools.DESCRIPTION: Validates DNSKEY self-signatures, RRSIGs on supplied RRsets and the DS-to-DNSKEY match for one zone, and flags weak algorithms or expiring signatures. Offline (zone text) or passive live queries.
tools.SOURCE: CyberScan original implementation; dnspython (ISC) and cryptography (Apache-2.0/BSD) for validation

PRIVACY.data_handling: Only public DNS data for the zone is processed, in memory.
PRIVACY.external_services: With resolve=true, DNSKEY/DS/SOA queries for the zone go to the system or given resolver.

tools.NAME: Network Configuration Analyzer
tools.DESCRIPTION: Audits sshd_config and Cisco IOS-style device configurations for weak authentication, cleartext management, default SNMP communities, weak ciphers and missing hardening. Text analysis only; nothing is contacted.
tools.SOURCE: CyberScan original implementation

PRIVACY.data_handling: The configuration text is analysed in memory; secrets in it are masked in the output.

tools.NAME: Public IP Reputation Checker
tools.DESCRIPTION: Classifies IP addresses (private, reserved, bogon, documentation, CGNAT, multicast) and matches them against user-supplied CIDR blocklists and allowlists. No built-in or online reputation feed is used.
tools.SOURCE: CyberScan original implementation; special-purpose ranges from the IANA IPv4/IPv6 Special-Purpose Address Registries

PRIVACY.data_handling: Addresses and lists are matched in memory; nothing is sent anywhere.
PRIVACY.external_services: None. Online reputation services are deliberately not queried.

tools.NAME: Authorized Service Exposure Checker
tools.DESCRIPTION: Flags risky listening services from a netstat/ss listing, or TCP-connect-checks a small set of ports on hosts you are authorized to test. Connect only: no payloads, banner grabbing, brute force or exploitation.
tools.SOURCE: CyberScan original implementation

PRIVACY.data_handling: Socket listings are parsed in memory. Probe mode only opens and closes TCP connections.
PRIVACY.external_services: Probe mode connects to the hosts you list; listing mode contacts nothing.

tools.NAME: Network Traffic Metadata Analyzer
tools.DESCRIPTION: Reads pcap/pcapng captures (headers and DNS question names only), builds flows and flags cleartext protocols, port scans, periodic beaconing, DNS tunnelling patterns and unusual outbound volume.
tools.SOURCE: CyberScan original implementation (pcap/pcapng parsing with the Python standard library)

PRIVACY.data_handling: The capture is parsed in memory; only header fields and DNS names are used, payloads are discarded.

tools.NAME: Certificate Chain Validator
tools.DESCRIPTION: Validates a TLS certificate chain (PEM or from one handshake): trust path, signatures, dates, host name, key sizes, SHA-1/MD5 signatures and CA constraints.
tools.SOURCE: CyberScan original implementation; cryptography (Apache-2.0/BSD) and certifi (MPL-2.0) trust store

PRIVACY.data_handling: Certificates are public data and are parsed in memory.
PRIVACY.external_services: Only when 'host' is given: one TLS handshake to that host and port.

external_services: The TLS server named in 'host' (live mode only)

tools.NAME: HSTS Configuration Checker
tools.DESCRIPTION: Checks the Strict-Transport-Security header (syntax, max-age, includeSubDomains, preload readiness, duplicates, delivery over HTTP) from pasted headers or one passive request to a named URL.
tools.SOURCE: CyberScan original implementation (RFC 6797; hstspreload.org submission requirements)

PRIVACY.data_handling: Response headers are parsed in memory; response bodies are not kept.
PRIVACY.external_services: Only with 'url': one HTTPS request (and one HTTP request if check_http_redirect).

external_services: The web server named in 'url' (live mode only)

tools.NAME: MTA-STS Validator
tools.DESCRIPTION: Validates the MTA-STS TXT record and policy (version, mode, mx patterns, max_age), checks that MX hosts match the policy and that TLS-RPT reporting is configured. Offline or passive DNS/HTTPS lookups.
tools.SOURCE: CyberScan original implementation (RFC 8461, RFC 8460); dnspython (ISC) for live lookups

PRIVACY.data_handling: Public DNS records and the public policy file are processed in memory.
PRIVACY.external_services: Live mode: DNS queries for the domain, and one HTTPS GET of its policy file if fetch_policy.

tools.NAME: Network Anomaly Analyzer
tools.DESCRIPTION: Finds scans, sweeps, beaconing, DNS tunnelling and unusual outbound volume in exported flow records (JSON, CSV or Zeek conn.log). Behavioural heuristics, not confirmed compromise.
tools.SOURCE: CyberScan original implementation

PRIVACY.data_handling: Flow records (addresses, ports, byte counts) are analysed in memory.

tools.NAME: Installed Software Risk Analyzer
tools.DESCRIPTION: Flags installed software past end of support (bundled, dated lifecycle table), remote-access tools, installs in user-writable folders and unknown publishers. No CVE lookup is performed.
tools.SOURCE: CyberScan original implementation; lifecycle dates from vendor lifecycle pages and endoflife.date (snapshot 2026-11-10)

PRIVACY.data_handling: The software inventory is analysed in memory. Local mode reads the Windows Uninstall registry keys only.

tools.NAME: Startup Entry Analyzer
tools.DESCRIPTION: Inspects Run/RunOnce and Startup-folder autostart entries (list, .reg export or local read-only) for user-writable paths, masquerading, encoded PowerShell, LOLBin abuse and unquoted paths.
tools.SOURCE: CyberScan original implementation; reuses detection.script_rules (frozen engine)

PRIVACY.data_handling: Autostart entries are analysed in memory; command-line secrets are masked in the output.

tools.NAME: Process Security Analyzer
tools.DESCRIPTION: Analyses a process snapshot for user-writable executables, masquerading names, suspicious parent-child chains (Office -> shell), encoded/LOLBin command lines and duplicated singleton system processes.
tools.SOURCE: CyberScan original implementation; psutil (BSD-3) for local snapshots; reuses detection.script_rules

PRIVACY.data_handling: The process list is analysed in memory; command lines are masked in the output.

local_access: process list: name, path, command line, parent, user (read)

tools.NAME: Firewall Configuration Checker
tools.DESCRIPTION: Checks Windows Firewall profiles and rules (netsh), iptables-save and ufw for disabled profiles, allow-by-default inbound policy and rules exposing remote-admin or file-sharing ports to any address.
tools.SOURCE: CyberScan original implementation

PRIVACY.data_handling: Firewall configuration text is analysed in memory.

local_access: netsh advfirewall firewall show rule name=all (read-only)

tools.NAME: System Update Status Checker
tools.DESCRIPTION: Checks OS release support (dated lifecycle tables for Windows builds and major Linux distributions), age of the newest installed Windows hotfix, and pending apt security updates.
tools.SOURCE: CyberScan original implementation; lifecycle dates from Microsoft, Ubuntu, Debian and endoflife.date (snapshot 2026-11-10)

PRIVACY.data_handling: OS version and update lists are analysed in memory.

tools.NAME: Local Permission Analyzer
tools.DESCRIPTION: Flags world-writable files and folders, setuid/setgid binaries, private keys readable by others and Windows ACLs that let broad groups modify files, from ls -l/icacls output or a read-only walk of listed paths.
tools.SOURCE: CyberScan original implementation

PRIVACY.data_handling: Only file names and permission metadata are read; file contents are never opened.

local_access: metadata (stat) of the listed paths and their children, up to max_depth

tools.NAME: Scheduled Task Analyzer
tools.DESCRIPTION: Reviews Windows scheduled-task XML and cron tables for tasks launching from temporary folders, encoded or LOLBin commands, download-and-run cron jobs and hidden privileged tasks triggered at boot or logon.
tools.SOURCE: CyberScan original implementation; reuses detection.script_rules (frozen engine)

PRIVACY.data_handling: Task definitions are parsed in memory; command-line secrets are masked.

tools.NAME: Browser Extension Risk Analyzer
tools.DESCRIPTION: Rates browser extensions (manifest, .crx/.zip/.xpi package or local browser profiles) for powerful permissions, all-site session access, weakened CSP, off-store updates, Manifest V2 and broad injection.
tools.SOURCE: CyberScan original implementation; reuses detection.archives.inspect_browser_extension (frozen engine)

PRIVACY.data_handling: Manifests and packages are read in memory. Local mode reads only extension manifest files in browser profiles.

tools.NAME: System Configuration Auditor
tools.DESCRIPTION: Audits Windows registry security settings (.reg export or local read-only) and Linux kernel sysctl values against common hardening baselines: UAC, credential protection, legacy protocols, RDP, AutoRun, ASLR and more.
tools.SOURCE: CyberScan original implementation; checks follow Microsoft security baselines and CIS benchmark items

PRIVACY.data_handling: Configuration values are analysed in memory.

tools.NAME: Persistence Configuration Auditor
tools.DESCRIPTION: Audits Windows persistence registry points (Winlogon, IFEO, AppInit, LSA packages, services, COM hijacks...) and Linux persistence files (systemd, rc, shell profiles, authorized_keys, ld.so.preload, udev).
tools.SOURCE: CyberScan original implementation; mechanisms follow MITRE ATT&CK T1546/T1547/T1543/T1574

PRIVACY.data_handling: Registry exports and files are analysed in memory; command-line secrets are masked.

tools.NAME: EXIF Metadata Analyzer
tools.DESCRIPTION: Lists privacy-relevant image metadata: GPS location, device serial numbers, owner names, timestamps, software, embedded thumbnails and XMP/IPTC/comment blocks (JPEG, PNG, WebP, TIFF).
tools.SOURCE: CyberScan original implementation; Pillow (MIT-CMU) decodes EXIF values

PRIVACY.data_handling: The image is parsed in memory and never stored. GPS coordinates in the result are rounded to about 1 km.

dependencies: Pillow (EXIF value decoding; structure-only without it)

tools.NAME: PII Detector
tools.DESCRIPTION: Detects personal data (emails, cards, IBANs, SSNs, Saudi IDs, UK NINOs, phones, IPs, birth dates, passports) with checksum validation where one exists, and reports masked samples, counts and line numbers.
tools.SOURCE: CyberScan original implementation

PRIVACY.data_handling: Text is scanned in memory; detected values are masked in the result and never stored.

tools.NAME: Sensitive Data Detector
tools.DESCRIPTION: Assigns a sensitivity level to text from classification markings (English and Arabic) and sensitive content categories: health, financial, HR, legal privilege, credentials and personal data.
tools.SOURCE: CyberScan original implementation

PRIVACY.data_handling: Text is scanned in memory; only categories, counts and line numbers are reported.

tools.NAME: API Key Exposure Detector
tools.DESCRIPTION: Detects exposed API keys and tokens for 30+ providers in text and reports masked previews, fingerprints and lines. Keys are never validated against providers.
tools.SOURCE: CyberScan original implementation; reuses detection.secrets.scan_secrets (frozen engine)

PRIVACY.data_handling: Text is scanned in memory; key values are masked and fingerprinted, never returned or stored.
PRIVACY.external_services: None: keys are never sent to providers for validation.

tools.NAME: Credential Exposure Detector
tools.DESCRIPTION: Detects exposed passwords and private keys: PEM/SSH keys, service-account keys, credentials in connection strings and URLs, Basic auth, .netrc, htpasswd, unattend.xml and hard-coded password assignments.
tools.SOURCE: CyberScan original implementation; reuses detection.secrets.scan_secrets (frozen engine)

PRIVACY.data_handling: Text is scanned in memory; credentials are masked and fingerprinted, never returned or stored.

tools.NAME: Log Privacy Analyzer
tools.DESCRIPTION: Scans log files for credentials, tokens, session cookies, secrets in query strings, logged passwords, personal data and stack traces, and suggests masking patterns. Values are masked in the output.
tools.SOURCE: CyberScan original implementation

PRIVACY.data_handling: Log lines are scanned in memory; only categories, counts, line numbers and masked samples are returned.

tools.NAME: Cookie Tracking Analyzer
tools.DESCRIPTION: Identifies tracking cookies (bundled vendor list), third-party and long-lived cookies, and missing Secure/HttpOnly/SameSite protection on session cookies, from Set-Cookie headers, HAR files or cookies.txt.
tools.SOURCE: CyberScan original implementation; tracker names from vendors' cookie documentation (snapshot 2026-11-10)

PRIVACY.data_handling: Cookie names and attributes are analysed in memory; cookie values are never returned.

tools.NAME: Browser Privacy Analyzer
tools.DESCRIPTION: Audits Chromium Preferences/Local State and Firefox prefs.js for disabled Safe Browsing, third-party cookies, disabled tracking protection, password-leak detection, DNS-over-HTTPS and site permissions granted by default.
tools.SOURCE: CyberScan original implementation

PRIVACY.data_handling: Only setting values are read; history, cookies and saved passwords are never opened.

tools.NAME: Data Leakage Detector
tools.DESCRIPTION: Pre-sharing check for text, DOCX/XLSX/PPTX and PDF: secrets, personal data, internal host names and paths, author/company metadata, comments, tracked changes, hidden text, embedded objects and old PDF revisions.
tools.SOURCE: CyberScan original implementation

PRIVACY.data_handling: Content is analysed in memory; secrets and personal data are masked in the result.

tools.NAME: Metadata Removal Validator
tools.DESCRIPTION: Checks that metadata was actually stripped from an image, Office document or PDF, and (given the original) lists what was removed and what remains. Pass/fail per check.
tools.SOURCE: CyberScan original implementation

PRIVACY.data_handling: Both files are parsed in memory; metadata values are summarised, not stored.

tools.NAME: Source Code Security Scanner
tools.DESCRIPTION: Static analysis for injection sinks, disabled TLS verification, weak crypto, insecure randomness, debug mode, insecure temp files and permissions in Python (AST), JS/TS, PHP, Java, Go, C/C++, C# and Ruby.
tools.SOURCE: CyberScan original implementation; rule categories follow CWE (78, 94, 95, 295, 327, 330, 377, 489, 732)

PRIVACY.data_handling: Source code is analysed in memory and never executed or stored.

tools.NAME: Dependency Vulnerability Checker
tools.DESCRIPTION: Finds dependency versions affected by OSV advisories: offline against advisories you supply, or (opt-in) via the public OSV.dev API. Supports 12 manifest/lockfile formats across PyPI, npm, Go, RubyGems, Packagist, crates.io, Maven.
tools.SOURCE: CyberScan original implementation; OSV schema; optional OSV.dev API (Google, data CC-BY 4.0); packaging (Apache-2.0/BSD)

PRIVACY.data_handling: Manifests are parsed in memory.
PRIVACY.external_services: Only with online=true: package names, ecosystems and versions are sent to https://api.osv.dev.

tools.NAME: Secrets Scanner
tools.DESCRIPTION: Scans a set of files or a local directory for committed secrets, de-duplicates them by fingerprint, downgrades test/docs matches and flags secret-bearing files (.env, keys, keystores). Values are never shown.
tools.SOURCE: CyberScan original implementation; reuses detection.secrets.scan_secrets (frozen engine)

PRIVACY.data_handling: Files are read in memory; secret values are fingerprinted and masked, never returned.

local_access: files under 'directory' (read-only; .git, node_modules, venvs and binaries skipped)

tools.NAME: License Compliance Checker
tools.DESCRIPTION: Classifies dependency licenses (SPDX expressions, free-text names, LICENSE file texts) and flags conflicts with the chosen distribution model (proprietary, SaaS, internal, open source) plus allow/deny lists. Not legal advice.
tools.SOURCE: CyberScan original implementation; license identifiers from the SPDX License List

PRIVACY.data_handling: Package names and license strings are analysed in memory.

tools.NAME: SBOM Generator
tools.DESCRIPTION: Generates a reproducible CycloneDX 1.5 JSON SBOM (components, purls, scopes, licenses, hashes) from manifests and lockfiles, and reports unresolved versions and missing hashes.
tools.SOURCE: CyberScan original implementation; CycloneDX 1.5 specification (OWASP)

PRIVACY.data_handling: Manifests are parsed in memory; the SBOM is returned, not stored.

tools.NAME: Lockfile Integrity Checker
tools.DESCRIPTION: Audits lockfiles and requirements for unpinned versions, missing/weak integrity hashes, HTTP or git sources, extra indexes (dependency confusion), trusted hosts and manifest/lockfile drift.
tools.SOURCE: CyberScan original implementation

PRIVACY.data_handling: Lockfiles are parsed in memory.

tools.NAME: Unsafe Deserialization Detector
tools.DESCRIPTION: Finds unsafe deserialization in Python, Java, .NET, PHP, Ruby and Node code, and inspects serialized blobs (pickle opcodes, Java/.NET/PHP formats) without loading them.
tools.SOURCE: CyberScan original implementation (CWE-502)

PRIVACY.data_handling: Code and blobs are analysed in memory; blobs are never deserialized.

tools.NAME: SQL Injection Pattern Detector
tools.DESCRIPTION: Detects SQL built by concatenation, f-strings, % or .format instead of bound parameters (Python AST; JS/TS, PHP, Java, C#, Go, Ruby patterns), with higher severity when request input is read nearby.
tools.SOURCE: CyberScan original implementation (CWE-89)

PRIVACY.data_handling: Source code is analysed in memory and never executed.

tools.NAME: XSS Pattern Detector
tools.DESCRIPTION: Detects cross-site-scripting patterns: DOM sinks, framework escape hatches, disabled template auto-escaping, javascript: URLs, PHP echo of request data and Flask render_template_string, with source-aware severity.
tools.SOURCE: CyberScan original implementation (CWE-79)

PRIVACY.data_handling: Source code is analysed in memory and never executed.

tools.NAME: Secure Configuration Analyzer
tools.DESCRIPTION: Checks Django, nginx, Apache, php.ini, .env and Spring Boot configuration for debug mode, wildcard hosts/CORS, insecure cookies, directory listing, version disclosure, legacy TLS, exposed actuators and hard-coded secrets.
tools.SOURCE: CyberScan original implementation; checks follow OWASP ASVS V14 and vendor hardening guides

PRIVACY.data_handling: Configuration is analysed in memory; secret values are masked.

tools.NAME: Cloud Configuration Analyzer
tools.DESCRIPTION: Audits exported AWS, Azure and GCP configuration JSON (security groups/NSGs/firewall rules, instances, databases, volumes, CloudTrail, storage accounts, Cloud SQL) for exposure, missing encryption and logging gaps. Offline only.
tools.SOURCE: CyberScan original implementation; checks follow CIS AWS/Azure/GCP Foundations benchmark items

PRIVACY.data_handling: Configuration exports are analysed in memory.
PRIVACY.external_services: None. No cloud credentials are needed or accepted; nothing is queried.

tools.NAME: Public Storage Exposure Checker
tools.DESCRIPTION: Checks S3 bucket policies/ACLs/Block Public Access, Azure container access and GCS IAM for public exposure, and optionally confirms anonymous listing with one request to an authorized bucket URL.
tools.SOURCE: CyberScan original implementation

PRIVACY.data_handling: Policies and ACLs are analysed in memory.
PRIVACY.external_services: Only with probe_url and authorization_confirmed: one anonymous HTTPS GET to that URL.

tools.NAME: IAM Configuration Auditor
tools.DESCRIPTION: Audits AWS IAM policies and trust policies (admin wildcards, privilege-escalation paths), the AWS credential report (root keys, missing MFA, old keys), Azure role definitions and GCP IAM bindings.
tools.SOURCE: CyberScan original implementation; escalation paths from public AWS IAM privilege-escalation research

PRIVACY.data_handling: Policies and the credential report (user names, dates; no secrets) are analysed in memory.
PRIVACY.external_services: None. No credentials are needed; nothing is queried.

tools.NAME: Infrastructure-as-Code Scanner
tools.DESCRIPTION: Scans Terraform and CloudFormation templates for open security groups, public storage, missing encryption, public databases, IMDSv1 and over-privileged IAM, using the same rules as the cloud configuration tools.
tools.SOURCE: CyberScan original implementation; PyYAML (MIT) for CloudFormation YAML

PRIVACY.data_handling: Templates are parsed in memory and never applied or evaluated.

tools.NAME: Container Configuration Analyzer
tools.DESCRIPTION: Audits Dockerfiles and docker-compose files for unpinned images, root users, secrets in layers, curl|sh, privileged containers, host namespaces, Docker-socket and host mounts, capabilities and exposed databases.
tools.SOURCE: CyberScan original implementation; checks follow the CIS Docker Benchmark

PRIVACY.data_handling: Files are parsed in memory; images are not pulled or built.

tools.NAME: Kubernetes Configuration Auditor
tools.DESCRIPTION: Checks Kubernetes manifests against Pod Security Standards (privileged, host namespaces, hostPath, capabilities, root, seccomp) plus RBAC wildcards, anonymous bindings, inline secrets, resource limits and exposed services.
tools.SOURCE: CyberScan original implementation; Kubernetes Pod Security Standards (baseline/restricted)

PRIVACY.data_handling: Manifests are parsed in memory; no cluster is contacted.

tools.NAME: Git Repository Security Scanner
tools.DESCRIPTION: Checks a Git repository for credentials in remote URLs, insecure remotes/submodules, sslVerify=false, plaintext credential helpers, active hooks, committed keys/.env/tfstate/dumps, .gitignore gaps and secrets in files.
tools.SOURCE: CyberScan original implementation

PRIVACY.data_handling: Repository files are read in memory; secret values are masked. git is never executed.

tools.NAME: CI/CD Configuration Analyzer
tools.DESCRIPTION: Checks GitHub Actions, GitLab CI and Jenkinsfiles for pwn-request triggers, script injection, unpinned actions, over-broad token permissions, leaked secrets, self-hosted runner exposure and unsafe shell steps.
tools.SOURCE: CyberScan original implementation; follows GitHub's 'Security hardening for GitHub Actions' guidance

PRIVACY.data_handling: Pipeline files are parsed in memory.

tools.NAME: Backup Configuration Auditor
tools.DESCRIPTION: Audits backup policies (generic JSON/YAML or AWS Backup plans/vaults) for 3-2-1 compliance, encryption, immutability, retention, frequency, failing jobs, untested restores and embedded credentials.
tools.SOURCE: CyberScan original implementation; 3-2-1 rule and NIST SP 800-209 / CISA ransomware guidance

PRIVACY.data_handling: Backup configuration is analysed in memory; secrets in it are masked.

tools.NAME: Cloud Asset Exposure Analyzer
tools.DESCRIPTION: Maps internet exposure across a cloud asset inventory (public IPs, load balancers, open admin/database ports, plain HTTP, missing owners) and finds dangling DNS records pointing at cloud hostnames no longer owned.
tools.SOURCE: CyberScan original implementation; takeover-prone service suffixes from public subdomain-takeover research

PRIVACY.data_handling: The inventory is analysed in memory; nothing is resolved or contacted.
